content.text:
**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The only MFN-style commitment in the Agreement benefits us: MSL agrees its engineering will be priced to IBM on a "most favored customer" basis (p1099). Section 8.2 similarly runs vendor-side, passing parts price reductions through to IBM. Targeted searches (most favoured / no less favourable / best price / lower price / price matching / right of first refusal) and review of the pricing provisions (Sections 7.0 and 8.2) surfaced no obligation requiring IBM to give MSL terms no less favourable than those offered to third parties. This sits at the preferred position, and per the rule's direction guidance the vendor-granted MFN is left untouched.
